prompt:
High-fidelity product UI design comp, portrait 440x960-ish Chrome extension side panel, no phone frame, no browser frame, no surrounding desktop. Product: CueWave, a YouTube semantic probe tool. This is a real Chinese OPERATE interface for rapid add-probe → time-ranked hotspot results, not a marketing poster. Direction: “时间登机牌 / Time Boarding Pass” — boarding-pass segments fused with a live airport gate-board fixed column grid. Commit completely to the information grammar of perforated segmented tickets and live departure boards without illustrating an airport. High-contrast warm off-white #F7F6F0 ground and charcoal #18212A ink; alert orange #F05A3C only for a newly changed hotspot; ready green #3B8C74 only for connected / transcript-ready / analyzed-ready states; cool rule grey #D6D9D8. Monospaced tabular times and numbers, condensed utilitarian Chinese labels, hard 1px rules, square or very slightly rounded controls, dense but calm, compact and highly scannable. No gradients, glass, shadows, photos, illustrations, maps, planes, airport scenery, generic dashboard cards, generic rounded card stacks, giant hero text, or invented marketing claims.

The screen is one coherent operational sheet, not separate floating cards. Top to bottom structure: a narrow charcoal masthead reading “CueWave” and “已连接” with a small green ready dot; directly beneath, the current video is a compact tear-off boarding-pass segment with tiny field labels “当前视频 / 时长 / 来源”, title “为什么我们会被算法影响？”, duration “18:42”, source “YouTube”, and a small “演示数据” marker. Then a dominant quick-add probe strip: label “新增语义探针”, input placeholder “输入你想在视频里寻找的内容…”, a compact hard-edged “＋ 添加” action, example hint “算法推荐的原理｜信息茧房｜平台如何赚钱”. Beneath it, a fixed ticket-stub row for active probes in exactly this order: “知识科普” selected, “幽默程度”, “推广信息”; use charcoal outlines and tiny status fields, not colorful pills. Follow with one clear primary control “分析视频” and a slim green-ready line “字幕已就绪 · 可立即分析”.

Main focal region: “语义时间轴” rendered as a compact continuous 00:00–18:42 strip, with three aligned narrow histogram lanes for the same probes. Keep the selected “知识科普” lane darkest and clearest; the other two remain visible but quiet. Show hotspot markers at exactly 04:18, 11:32, 16:05 and preserve the full continuous time axis. Immediately below, transform “最高热点 · 知识科普” into a live gate-board table with rigid aligned columns and a strong header row: “序 / 时间 / 强度 / 原句核对 / 状态”. Rows are ordered in video time and use monospaced times: 01 04:18, 02 11:32, 03 16:05. Keep the same evidence content from the existing CueWave comp: row 01 “算法通过多层模型预测你的兴趣，本质上是进行概率估计……” ; row 02 “当我们不断看到相似内容时，会逐渐进入‘信息茧房’……” ; row 03 “平台的商业模式是通过用户注意力来获取广告收入……”. Each row has an explicit “跳转” affordance. Mark only row 02 with a small orange “有更新” change flag; rows 01 and 03 use quiet charcoal status text “可核对”, not green. Use green only for the overall readiness state. The grid should feel like live departures continuously re-sorting while remaining implementable in HTML/CSS, with crisp fixed columns and no cramped ornamental numbering.

Bottom utility ticket strip, divided by vertical rules, contains only: “字幕：YouTube 自动生成”, “探针定义”, “历史记录”, “本月用量 12/500”. Make every control and status legible at the portrait side-panel scale. The one-glance task path must be unmistakable: add a semantic probe, see its full-video timeline, scan time-ranked hotspots, jump back to the original sentence. Real software surface only.
